problem: A quality-qualified required reviewer can be temporarily impossible to execute under active provider, privacy, price, context or fee gates.

separation.quality_qualification: Evidence that a model may satisfy a required independent-review slot.
separation.transport_availability: Whether that exact qualified model can execute now under active operational gates.

rules: Transport unavailability is not a quality failure.
Transport unavailability does not complete the required reviewer slot.
No silent model substitution is permitted.
An explicitly authorized cheap CHALLENGER_ONLY model may provide adversarial proposal evidence while a required slot is unavailable.
CHALLENGER_ONLY evidence never counts as required-slot completion or independent convergence.
Final high-risk convergence remains non-PASS until the required slot is available or a replacement is qualified under the governed shadow-replacement policy.
Provider, privacy, budget, context and fee gates are not weakened by this proposal.
Reviewer agreement creates no semantic or canonical authority.
candidate_note: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash may be explored only as CHALLENGER_ONLY or through the existing shadow-qualification process; this proposal does not qualify it as a replacement.
